reply.text:
That sounds frightening, and I want you to treat it as urgent. Chest, arm or jaw pain together with feeling sick during exertion can be a heart problem, so please stop running now, sit down somewhere safe, and call your local emergency number (911 in the US) or have someone take you to an emergency room straight away. Don't wait to see if it passes.

I'm a strength and endurance coach, so I can't tell you what this is, and that one needs a doctor right away, not a coach. Once you've been checked and cleared, tell me what they say and we'll work out how to get you back to running safely.
